rows.en: Nearly a week passed before the girl was able to explain what had happened to her.
rows.zh: 将近一个星期过去后，这个姑娘才说得清自己遭遇了什么。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: One afternoon she set out from the coast in a small boat and was caught in a storm.
rows.zh: 一天下午，她驾着一艘小船从海岸出发，遇上了风暴。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Towards evening, the boat struck a rock and the girl jumped into the sea.
rows.zh: 傍晚时，小船撞上一块礁石，姑娘跳进了海里。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Then she swam to the shore after spending the whole night in the water.
rows.zh: 她在水里度过了整整一夜，随后才游到岸边。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: During that time she covered a distance of eight miles.
rows.zh: 在那段时间里，她游了八英里。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Early next morning, she saw a light ahead.
rows.zh: 第二天清晨，她看见前方有灯光。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: She knew she was near the shore because the light was high up on the cliffs.
rows.zh: 她知道自己已靠近海岸，因为灯光高高地亮在悬崖上。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: On arriving at the shore, the girl struggled up the cliff towards the light she had seen.
rows.zh: 一到岸边，姑娘就挣扎着爬上悬崖，朝她先前看到的灯光爬去。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: That was all she remembered.
rows.zh: 她能记起的只有这些。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: When she woke up a day later, she found herself in hospital.
rows.zh: 一天后醒来时，她发现自己在医院里。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Dan Robinson has been worried all week.
rows.zh: 丹·鲁宾逊整个星期都很担心。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Last Tuesday he received a letter from the local police.
rows.zh: 上星期二，他收到了当地警察的一封信。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: In the letter he was asked to call at the station.
rows.zh: 信里请他到警察局去一趟。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Dan wondered why he was wanted by the police, but he went to the station yesterday and now he is not worried anymore.
rows.zh: 丹不明白警察为什么找他，但他昨天还是去了警察局，现在已经不再担心了。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: At the station, he was told by a smiling policeman that his bicycle had been found.
rows.zh: 在警察局，一位面带微笑的警察告诉他，他的自行车找到了。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Five days ago, the policeman told him, the bicycle was picked up in a small village four hundred miles away.
rows.zh: 警察告诉他，五天前，有人在四百英里以外的一个小村庄里发现了那辆自行车。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: It is now being sent to his home by train.
rows.zh: 现在，这辆自行车正由火车运往他家。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Dan was most surprised when he heard the news.
rows.zh: 丹听到这个消息时，非常吃惊。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: He was amused too, because he never expected the bicycle to be found.
rows.zh: 他同时又觉得好笑，因为他从没指望还能找到这辆自行车。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: It was stolen twenty years ago when Dan was a boy of fifteen!
rows.zh: 那辆车是二十年前被偷的，当时丹还是个十五岁的男孩子！
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Roy Trenton used to drive a taxi.
rows.zh: 罗伊·特伦顿过去开出租车。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: A short while ago, however, he became a bus driver and he has not regretted it.
rows.zh: 不过，不久前他当上了公共汽车司机，而且一直没有后悔。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: He is finding his new work far more exciting.
rows.zh: 他觉得自己的新工作刺激得多。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: When he was driving along Catford Street recently, he saw two thieves rush out of a shop and run towards a waiting car.
rows.zh: 最近，他沿着卡特福德街开车时，看见两个窃贼从一家商店冲出来，朝一辆等在那里的汽车跑去。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: One of them was carrying a bag full of money.
rows.zh: 其中一个人提着一只装满钱的袋子。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Roy acted quickly and drove the bus straight at the thieves.
rows.zh: 罗伊迅速采取行动，开着公共汽车直冲窃贼而去。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The one with the money got such a fright that he dropped the bag.
rows.zh: 那个提钱的人吓得把袋子都掉了。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: As the thieves were trying to get away in their car, Roy drove his bus into the back of it.
rows.zh: 窃贼正想开车逃走时，罗伊开着公共汽车撞上了他们汽车的尾部。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: While the battered car was moving away, Roy stopped his bus and telephoned the police.
rows.zh: 那辆被撞坏的汽车开走时，罗伊停下公共汽车，打电话报了警。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The thieves’ car was badly damaged and easy to recognize.
rows.zh: 窃贼的汽车损坏严重，很容易辨认。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Shortly afterwards, the police stopped the car and both men were arrested.
rows.zh: 不久，警察拦住了那辆汽车，两个人都被捕了。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Debbie Hart is going to swim across the English Channel tomorrow.
rows.zh: 黛比·哈特明天打算游过英吉利海峡。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: She is going to set out from the French coast at five o'clock in the morning.
rows.zh: 她计划早晨五点从法国海岸出发。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Debbie is only eleven years old and she hopes to set up a new world record.
rows.zh: 黛比只有十一岁，她希望创造一项新的世界纪录。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: She is a strong swimmer and many people feel that she is sure to succeed.
rows.zh: 她是一位游泳健将，许多人认为她一定会成功。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Debbie's father will set out with her in a small boat.
rows.zh: 黛比的父亲将驾着一艘小船陪她一同出发。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Mr. Hart has trained his daughter for years.
rows.zh: 哈特先生多年来一直在训练自己的女儿。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Tomorrow he will be watching her anxiously as she swims the long distance to England.
rows.zh: 明天，当她长距离游向英国时，他会焦急地注视着她。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Debbie intends to take short rests every two hours.
rows.zh: 黛比打算每隔两小时短暂休息一次。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: She will have something to drink but she will not eat any solid food.
rows.zh: 她会喝些东西，但不会吃任何固体食物。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Most of Debbie’s school friends will be waiting for her on the English coast.
rows.zh: 黛比的大多数同学将会在英国海岸等她。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Among them will be Debbie’s mother, who swam the Channel herself when she was a girl.
rows.zh: 等候的人中还有黛比的母亲，她在少女时代也曾亲自游过英吉利海峡。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The Olympic Games will be held in our country in four years’ time.
rows.zh: 四年以后，奥林匹克运动会将在我国举行。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: As a great many people will be visiting the country, the government will be building new hotels, an immense stadium, and a new Olympic-standard swimming pool.
rows.zh: 由于将有大批游客来到我国，政府将兴建新的旅馆、一座巨大的体育场，以及一座符合奥运标准的新游泳池。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: They will also be building new roads and a special railway line.
rows.zh: 政府还将修建新的道路和一条专用铁路线。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The Games will be held just outside the capital and the whole area will be called ‘Olympic City’.
rows.zh: 运动会将在首都近郊举行，整个地区将被称为“奥运城”。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Workers will have completed the new roads by the end of this year.
rows.zh: 到今年年底，工人们将修好这些新道路。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: By the end of next year, they will have finished work on the new stadium.
rows.zh: 到明年年底，他们将完成新体育场的建设。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The fantastic modern buildings have been designed by Kurt Gunter.
rows.zh: 这些出色的现代建筑已经由库尔特·冈特设计完成。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Everybody will be watching anxiously as the new buildings go up.
rows.zh: 随着新建筑一座座拔地而起，人人都会满怀期待地关注着。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: We are all very excited and are looking forward to the Olympic Games because they have never been held before in this country.
rows.zh: 我们都十分兴奋，盼望着奥运会，因为我国以前从未举办过奥运会。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: My old friend, Harrison, had lived in the Mediterranean for many years before he returned to England.
rows.zh: 我的老朋友哈里森回到英国以前，已经在地中海地区住了许多年。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: He had often dreamed of retiring in England and had planned to settle down in the country.
rows.zh: 他常常梦想在英国退休，并计划在乡下定居。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: He had no sooner returned than he bought a house and went to live there.
rows.zh: 他一回到英国，就买了一栋房子，住了进去。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Almost immediately he began to complain about the weather, for even though it was still summer, it rained continually and it was often bitterly cold.
rows.zh: 他几乎立刻就开始抱怨天气，因为虽然还是夏天，却不停地下雨，而且常常冷得刺骨。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: After so many years of sunshine, Harrison got a shock.
rows.zh: 享受了那么多年的阳光以后，哈里森对这样的天气大感意外。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: He acted as if he had never lived in England before.
rows.zh: 他的举止仿佛自己从前从未在英国住过一样。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: In the end, it was more than he could bear.
rows.zh: 到最后，这种天气实在让他无法忍受了。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: He had hardly had time to settle down when he sold the house and left the country.
rows.zh: 他几乎还没来得及安顿下来，就卖掉房子，离开了英国。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The dream he had had for so many years ended there.
rows.zh: 他多年来的梦想就此结束了。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Harrison had thought of everything except the weather.
rows.zh: 哈里森什么都考虑到了，唯独漏了天气。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: While John Gilbert was in hospital, he asked his doctor to tell him whether his operation had been successful, but the doctor refused to do so.
rows.zh: 约翰·吉尔伯特住院时，请医生告诉他手术是否成功，医生却拒绝回答。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The following day, the patient asked for a bedside telephone.
rows.zh: 第二天，这位病人要了一部床头电话。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: When he was alone, he telephoned the hospital exchange and asked for Doctor Millington.
rows.zh: 独自一人时，他拨通了医院总机，要求转接米林顿医生。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: When the doctor answered the phone, Mr. Gilbert said he was inquiring about a certain patient, a Mr. John Gilbert.
rows.zh: 医生接电话后，吉尔伯特先生说，他想打听一位名叫约翰·吉尔伯特的病人的情况。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: He asked if Mr. Gilbert's operation had been successful and the doctor told him that it had been.
rows.zh: 他问吉尔伯特先生的手术是否成功，医生告诉他手术成功了。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: He then asked when Mr. Gilbert would be allowed to go home and the doctor told him that he would have to stay in hosptial for another two weeks.
rows.zh: 接着，他问吉尔伯特先生什么时候可以回家，医生告诉他，还必须在医院住两个星期。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Then Dr. Millington asked the caller if he was a relative of the patient.
rows.zh: 随后，米林顿医生问来电者是不是病人的亲属。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: ‘No,’ the patient answered, ‘I am Mr. John Gilbert.’
rows.zh: “不是，”病人回答，“我就是约翰·吉尔伯特先生。”
rows.speaker: 约翰·吉尔伯特

rows.en: Last week at a dinner party, the hostess asked me to sit next to Mrs. Rumbold.
rows.zh: 上周参加一次晚宴时，女主人请我坐在兰博尔德太太身旁。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Mrs. Rumbold was a large, unsmiling lady in a tight black dress.
rows.zh: 兰博尔德太太体态丰腴，脸上毫无笑容，穿着一条紧身黑色连衣裙。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: She did not even look up when I took my seat beside her.
rows.zh: 我在她身旁坐下时，她连头也没抬。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Her eyes were fixed on her plate and in a short time, she was busy eating.
rows.zh: 她的眼睛一直盯着自己的盘子，不一会儿就忙着吃了起来。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: I tried to make conversation.
rows.zh: 我试着找话聊。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: ‘A new play is coming to “The Globe” soon,’ I said.
rows.zh: “环球剧院很快就要上演一出新戏了，”我说。
rows.speaker: 我

rows.en: ‘Will you be seeing it?’
rows.zh: “您会去看吗？”
rows.speaker: 我

rows.en: ‘No,’ she answered.
rows.zh: “不会，”她回答。
rows.speaker: 兰博尔德太太

rows.en: ‘Will you be spending your holidays abroad this year?’ I asked.
rows.zh: “您今年打算出国度假吗？”我问。
rows.speaker: 我

rows.en: ‘No,’ she answered.
rows.zh: “不打算，”她回答。
rows.speaker: 兰博尔德太太

rows.en: ‘Will you be staying in England?’ I asked.
rows.zh: “您会留在英国吗？”我问。
rows.speaker: 我

rows.en: ‘No,’ she answered.
rows.zh: “不会，”她回答。
rows.speaker: 兰博尔德太太

rows.en: In despair, I asked her whether she was enjoying her dinner.
rows.zh: 我实在没办法了，便问她这顿饭吃得是否愉快。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: ‘Young man,’ she answered, ‘if you ate more and talked less, we would both enjoy our dinner!’
rows.zh: “年轻人，”她回答，“如果你多吃一点、少说一点，我们两个都会吃得愉快！”
rows.speaker: 兰博尔德太太

lessons.title: Do you call that a hat?

rows.en: ‘Do you call that a hat?’ I said to my wife.
rows.zh: “你管那叫帽子？”我对妻子说。
rows.speaker: 我

rows.en: ‘You needn’t be so rude about it,’ my wife answered as she looked at herself in the mirror.
rows.zh: “你用不着说得这么难听，”妻子一边照镜子一边回答。
rows.speaker: 妻子

rows.en: I sat down on one of those modern chairs with holes in it and waited.
rows.zh: 我在一把带孔的现代式椅子上坐下来等着。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: We had been in the hat shop for half an hour and my wife was still in front of the mirror.
rows.zh: 我们已经在帽子店里待了半个小时，妻子还站在镜子前。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: ‘We musn’t buy things we don’t need,’ I remarked suddenly.
rows.zh: “我们可不能买不需要的东西，”我突然说。
rows.speaker: 我

rows.en: I regretted saying it almost at once.
rows.zh: 我几乎立刻就后悔说了这话。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: ‘You needn't have said that,’ my wife answered.
rows.zh: “你这话完全多余，”妻子回答。
rows.speaker: 妻子

rows.en: ‘I needn’t remind you of that terrible tie you bought yesterday.’
rows.zh: “不用我提醒你昨天买的那条难看的领带吧。”
rows.speaker: 妻子

rows.en: ‘I find it beautiful,’ I said.
rows.zh: “我觉得它很好看，”我说。
rows.speaker: 我

rows.en: ‘A man can never have too many ties.’
rows.zh: “男人的领带再多也不嫌多。”
rows.speaker: 我

rows.en: ‘And a woman can’t have too many hats,’ she answered.
rows.zh: “女人的帽子也是再多都不嫌多，”她回答。
rows.speaker: 妻子

rows.en: Ten minutes later we walked out of the shop together.
rows.zh: 十分钟后，我们一起走出了商店。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: My wife was wearing a hat that looked like a lighthouse!
rows.zh: 妻子头上戴着一顶看起来像灯塔的帽子！
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: As we had had a long walk through one of the markets of Old Delhi, we stopped at a square to have a rest.
rows.zh: 我们在老德里的一个集市里走了很长一段路，于是停在一处广场上休息。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: After a time, we noticed a snake charmer with two large baskets at the other side of the square, so we went to have a look at him.
rows.zh: 过了一会儿，我们注意到广场另一边有位带着两个大篮子的弄蛇人，便走过去看看。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: As soon as he saw us, he picked up a long pipe which was covered with coins and opened one of the baskets.
rows.zh: 他一看到我们，就拿起一支镶满硬币的长笛，打开了其中一个篮子。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: When he began to play a tune, we had our first glimpse of the snake.
rows.zh: 当他开始吹奏一支曲子时，我们才第一次看到了那条蛇。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: It rose out of the basket and began to follow the movements of the pipe.
rows.zh: 蛇从篮子里昂起身，开始随着笛子的摆动而移动。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: We were very much surprised when the snake charmer suddenly began to play jazz and modern pop songs.
rows.zh: 弄蛇人突然开始吹爵士乐和现代流行歌曲，让我们十分惊讶。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The snake, however, continued to ‘dance’ slowly.
rows.zh: 然而，那条蛇仍旧慢悠悠地“跳舞”。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: It obviously could not tell the difference between Indian music and jazz!
rows.zh: 显然，它分不出印度音乐和爵士乐之间的差别！
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: In 1929, three years after his flight over the North Pole, the American explorer, R.E. Byrd, successfully flew over the South Pole for the first time.
rows.zh: 1929年，也就是飞越北极三年之后，美国探险家R.E.伯德首次成功飞越了南极。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Though, at first, Byrd and his men were able to take a great many photographs of the mountains that lay below, they soon ran into serious trouble.
rows.zh: 虽然起初伯德和同伴们拍下了许多下方群山的照片，但他们很快就遇上了严重的困难。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: At one point, it seemed certain that their plane would crash.
rows.zh: 有一阵子，他们的飞机似乎肯定要坠毁了。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: It could only get over the mountains if it rose to 10,000 feet.
rows.zh: 飞机只有升到一万英尺的高度，才能飞越群山。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Byrd at once ordered his men to throw out two heavy food sacks.
rows.zh: 伯德立刻命令同伴们把两袋沉重的食物扔出去。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The plane was then able to rise and it cleared the mountains by 400 feet.
rows.zh: 飞机这才得以上升，从比山峰高四百英尺的地方飞越了群山。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Byrd now knew that he would be able to reach the South Pole which was 300 miles away, for there were no more mountains in sight.
rows.zh: 这时伯德知道，他能够到达三百英里以外的南极了，因为视野中再也看不到山了。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The aircraft was able to fly over the endless white plains without difficulty.
rows.zh: 飞机顺利地飞过了那无边无际的白色平原。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Mrs. Anne Sterling did not think of the risk she was taking when she ran through a forest after two men.
rows.zh: 安妮·斯特林太太在树林里追赶两名男子时，没有想到自己正冒着多大的风险。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: They had rushed up to her while she was having a picnic at the edge of a forest with her children and tried to steal her handbag.
rows.zh: 当时，她正和孩子们在树林边野餐，那两个人突然冲到她跟前，想抢她的手提包。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: In the struggle, the strap broke and, with the bag in their possession, both men started running through the trees.
rows.zh: 在争夺中，包带断了，两名男子拿着包开始在树林里奔跑。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Mrs. Sterling got so angry that she ran after them.
rows.zh: 斯特林太太气极了，便追赶他们。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: She was soon out of breath, but she continued to run.
rows.zh: 她很快就跑得气喘吁吁，但仍继续跑。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: When she caught up with them, she saw that they had sat down and were going through the contents of the bag, so she ran straight at them.
rows.zh: 她追上他们时，看见两个人已经坐下来，正在翻看包里的东西，于是径直向他们冲去。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The men got such a fright that they dropped the bag and ran away.
rows.zh: 那两个人吓得扔下包就逃跑了。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: ‘The strap needs mending,’ said Mrs. Sterling later, ‘but they did not steal anything.’
rows.zh: “包带需要修一修，”斯特林太太后来说，“不过，他们什么也没偷走。”
rows.speaker: 斯特林太太

rows.en: The whole village soon learnt that a large sum of money had been lost.
rows.zh: 整个村子很快就知道，有一大笔钱丢了。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Sam Benton, the local butcher, had lost his wallet while taking his savings to the post office.
rows.zh: 当地的肉贩萨姆·本顿把积蓄送往邮局时，丢了钱包。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Sam was sure that the wallet must have been found by one of the villagers, but it was not returned to him.
rows.zh: 萨姆确信钱包一定被某个村民捡到了，可是并没有人把钱包还给他。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Three months passed, and then one morning, Sam found his wallet outside his front door.
rows.zh: 三个月过去了，一天早晨，萨姆在自己家门外找到了钱包。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: It had been wrapped up in newspaper and it contained half the money he had lost, together with a note which said: ‘A thief, yes, but only 50 per cent a thief!’
rows.zh: 钱包用报纸包着，里面有他所丢钱款的一半，还附着一张便条，上面写着：“没错，是个小偷，不过只算百分之五十的小偷！”
rows.speaker: 旁白与便条作者

rows.en: Two months later, some more money was sent to Sam with another note: ‘Only 25 per cent a thief now!’
rows.zh: 两个月后，又有人给萨姆送来一些钱，附着另一张便条：“现在只算百分之二十五的小偷了！”
rows.speaker: 旁白与便条作者

rows.en: In time, all Sam’s money was paid back in this way.
rows.zh: 过了一段时间，萨姆的钱就这样全部还清了。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The last note said: ‘I am 100 per cent honest now!’
rows.zh: 最后一张便条写着：“我现在是百分之百的老实人了！”
rows.speaker: 旁白与便条作者

rows.en: When a plane from London arrived at Sydney airport, workers began to unload a number of wooden boxes which contained clothing.
rows.zh: 一架从伦敦飞来的飞机抵达悉尼机场后，工人们开始卸下一批装着衣服的木箱。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: No one could account for the fact that one of the boxes was extremely heavy.
rows.zh: 其中一个箱子格外沉重，谁也解释不了原因。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: It suddenly occurred to one of the workers to open up the box.
rows.zh: 一名工人突然想到把箱子打开看看。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: He was astonished at what he found.
rows.zh: 他看到箱子里的情形，大吃一惊。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: A man was lying in the box on top of a pile of woollen goods.
rows.zh: 一个男子躺在箱子里的一堆毛织品上。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: He was so surprised at being discovered that he did not even try to run away.
rows.zh: 他被人发现后，惊讶得连逃跑都没有尝试。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: After he was arrested, the man admitted hiding in the box before the plane left London.
rows.zh: 被捕后，这名男子承认自己是在飞机离开伦敦之前躲进箱子的。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: He had had a long and uncomfortable trip, for he had been confined to the wooden box for over eighteen hours.
rows.zh: 他经历了一趟漫长而难受的旅行，因为他被关在木箱里十八个多小时。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The man was ordered to pay £3,500 for the cost of the trip.
rows.zh: 这名男子被勒令支付三千五百英镑的旅费。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The normal price of a ticket is £2,000!
rows.zh: 正常票价是两千英镑！
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: A public house which was recently bought by Mr. Ian Thompson is up for sale.
rows.zh: 伊恩·汤普森先生最近买下的一家酒馆，现在正挂牌出售。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Mr. Thompson is going to sell it because it is haunted.
rows.zh: 汤普森先生打算卖掉酒馆，因为那里闹鬼。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: He told me that he could not go to sleep one night because he heard a strange noise coming from the bar.
rows.zh: 他告诉我，一天夜里，他听见酒吧间里传来一种奇怪的声音，因而无法入睡。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The next morning, he found that the doors had been blocked by chairs and the furniture had been moved.
rows.zh: 第二天早晨，他发现门被椅子堵住了，家具也被挪动了。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Though Mr. Thompson had turned the lights off before he went to bed, they were on in the morning.
rows.zh: 虽然汤普森先生睡前关了灯，可早晨灯却亮着。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: He also said that he had found five empty whisky bottles which the ghost must have drunk the night before.
rows.zh: 他还说，他发现了五个空威士忌酒瓶，一定是鬼在前一晚把里面的酒喝光了。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: When I suggested that some villagers must have come in for a free drink, Mr. Thompson shook his head.
rows.zh: 当我提出一定是一些村民进来喝了免费酒时，汤普森先生摇了摇头。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The villagers have told him that they will not accept the pub even if he gives it away.
rows.zh: 村民们已经告诉他，即使他把酒馆白送给他们，他们也不要。
rows.speaker: 旁白

lessons.title: Did you want to tell me something?

rows.en: Dentists always ask questions when it is impossible for you to answer.
rows.zh: 牙医总是在你不可能回答的时候提问。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: My dentist had just pulled out one of my teeth and had told me to rest for a while.
rows.zh: 我的牙医刚拔掉了我一颗牙，并叫我休息一会儿。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: I tried to say something, but my mouth was full of cotton wool.
rows.zh: 我想说点什么，可嘴里塞满了药棉。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: He knew I collected match boxes and asked me whether my collection was growing.
rows.zh: 他知道我收集火柴盒，便问我的收藏是不是又增加了。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: He then asked me how my brother was and whether I liked my new job in London.
rows.zh: 接着，他又问我兄弟的近况，以及我是否喜欢在伦敦的新工作。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: In answer to these questions I either nodded or made strange noises.
rows.zh: 回答这些问题时，我不是点头，就是发出奇怪的声音。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Meanwhile, my tongue was busy searching out the hole where the tooth had been.
rows.zh: 与此同时，我的舌头一直忙着寻找那颗牙原来所在的空洞。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: I suddenly felt very worried, but could not say anything.
rows.zh: 我突然很担心，却什么也说不出来。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: When the dentist at last removed the cotton wool from my mouth, I was able to tell him that he had pulled out the wrong tooth.
rows.zh: 牙医终于从我嘴里取出药棉时，我才得以告诉他，他把牙拔错了。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Tired of sleeping on the floor, a young man in Teheran saved up for years to buy a real bed.
rows.zh: 德黑兰有个年轻人厌倦了睡地板，为了买一张真正的床，他攒了好几年的钱。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: For the first time in his life, he became the proud owner of a bed which had springs and a mattress.
rows.zh: 他有生以来第一次拥有了一张带弹簧和床垫的床，心里十分得意。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Because the weather was very hot, he carried the bed on to the roof of his house.
rows.zh: 由于天气很热，他把床搬到了自己家的屋顶上。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: He slept very well for the first two nights, but on the third night, a storm blew up.
rows.zh: 头两个晚上他睡得很好，可到了第三个晚上，突然刮起了风暴。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: A gust of wind swept the bed off the roof and sent it crashing into the courtyard below.
rows.zh: 一阵狂风把床从屋顶卷了下去，使它重重地砸进下面的院子。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The young man did not wake up until the bed had struck the ground.
rows.zh: 直到床撞到地面，年轻人才醒过来。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Although the bed was smashed to pieces, the man was miraculously unhurt.
rows.zh: 虽然床摔得粉碎，他却奇迹般地毫发无伤。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: When he woke up, he was still on the mattress.
rows.zh: 醒来时，他仍然躺在床垫上。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Glancing at the bits of wood and metal that lay around him, the man sadly picked up the mattress and carried it into his house.
rows.zh: 他瞥了一眼散落在周围的木头和金属碎片，伤心地捡起床垫，把它搬进屋里。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: After he had put it on the floor, he promptly went to sleep again.
rows.zh: 他把床垫放在地板上，随即又睡着了。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: I love travelling in the country, but I don’t like losing my way.
rows.zh: 我喜欢到乡间旅行，但不喜欢迷路。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: I went on an excursion recently, but my trip took me longer than I expected.
rows.zh: 最近我出去游玩了一趟，但这次旅行花的时间比我预计的长。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: ‘I'm going to Woodford Green,’ I said to the conductor as I got on the bus, ‘but I don’t know where it is.’
rows.zh: “我要去伍德福德格林，”上公共汽车时，我对售票员说，“可是我不知道那地方在哪里。”
rows.speaker: 我

rows.en: ‘I'll tell you where to get off,’ answered the conductor.
rows.zh: “我会告诉你在哪里下车，”售票员回答。
rows.speaker: 售票员

rows.en: I sat in the front of the bus to get a good view of the countryside.
rows.zh: 为了好好欣赏乡村风光，我坐在车厢前部。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: After some time, the bus stopped.
rows.zh: 过了一段时间，公共汽车停了下来。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Looking round, I realized with a shock that I was the only passenger left on the bus.
rows.zh: 我环顾四周，惊讶地发现车上只剩我一个乘客了。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: ‘You'll have to get off here,’ the conductor said.
rows.zh: “你得在这里下车了，”售票员说。
rows.speaker: 售票员

rows.en: ‘This is as far as we go.’
rows.zh: “我们就开到这里。”
rows.speaker: 售票员

rows.en: ‘Is this Woodford Green?’ I asked.
rows.zh: “这里是伍德福德格林吗？”我问。
rows.speaker: 我

rows.en: ‘Oh dear,’ said the conductor suddenly.
rows.zh: “哎呀，”售票员突然说。
rows.speaker: 售票员

rows.en: ‘I forgot to put you off.’ .
rows.zh: “我忘了叫你下车。”
rows.speaker: 售票员

rows.en: ‘It doesn’t matter,’ I said.
rows.zh: “没关系，”我说。
rows.speaker: 我

rows.en: ‘I'll get off here.’
rows.zh: “我就在这里下车吧。”
rows.speaker: 我

rows.en: ‘We're going back now,’ said the conductor.
rows.zh: “我们现在要往回开了，”售票员说。
rows.speaker: 售票员

rows.en: ‘Well, in that case, I prefer to stay on the bus,’ I answered.
rows.zh: “哦，既然这样，我还是留在车上吧，”我回答。
rows.speaker: 我

rows.en: My friend, Hugh, has always been fat, but things got so bad recently that he decided to go on a diet.
rows.zh: 我的朋友休一直很胖，但最近胖得实在厉害，于是他决定节食。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: He began his diet a week ago.
rows.zh: 他是一周前开始节食的。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: First of all, he wrote out a long list of all the foods which were forbidden.
rows.zh: 首先，他写了一张长长的清单，列出所有禁止食用的食物。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The list included most of the things Hugh loves: butter, potatoes, rice, beer, milk, chocolate, and sweets.
rows.zh: 这张清单包括休爱吃的大多数东西：黄油、土豆、米饭、啤酒、牛奶、巧克力和糖果。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Yesterday I paid him a visit.
rows.zh: 昨天，我去看望他。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: I rang the bell and was not surprised to see that Hugh was still as fat as ever.
rows.zh: 我按了门铃，看到休仍然像以前一样胖，一点也不意外。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: He led me into his room and hurriedly hid a large parcel under his desk.
rows.zh: 他把我领进自己的房间，慌忙把一个大包裹藏到书桌下面。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: It was obvious that he was very embarrassed.
rows.zh: 很明显，他十分尴尬。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: When I asked him what he was doing, he smiled guiltily and then put the parcel on the desk.
rows.zh: 我问他在做什么时，他心虚地笑了笑，随后把包裹放到了书桌上。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: He explained that his diet was so strict that he had to reward himself occasionally.
rows.zh: 他解释说，自己节食太严格了，偶尔必须奖励一下自己。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Then he showed me the contents of the parcel.
rows.zh: 接着，他给我看了包裹里的东西。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: It contained five large bars of chocolate and three bags of sweets!
rows.zh: 里面装着五大块巧克力和三袋糖果！
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: We have just moved into a new house and I have been working hard all morning.
rows.zh: 我们刚搬进一所新房子，我整个上午一直都在忙碌。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: I have been trying to get my new room in order.
rows.zh: 我一直在设法把自己的新房间整理好。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: This has not been easy because I own over a thousand books.
rows.zh: 这并不容易，因为我有一千多本书。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: To make matters worse, the room is rather small, so I have temporarily put my books on the floor.
rows.zh: 更糟的是，房间相当小，所以我暂时把书放在了地板上。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: At the moment, they cover every inch of floor space and I actually have to walk on them to get in or out of the room.
rows.zh: 现在，书铺满了地板的每一寸地方，我进出房间竟然得踩着书走。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: A short while ago, my sister helped me to carry one of my old bookcases up the stairs.
rows.zh: 不久前，我的一位姐妹帮我把一个旧书柜搬上了楼。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: She went into my room and got a big surprise when she saw all those books on the floor.
rows.zh: 她走进我的房间，看见地板上的那些书，大吃一惊。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: ‘This is the prettiest carpet I have ever seen,’ she said.
rows.zh: “这是我见过的最漂亮的地毯，”她说。
rows.speaker: 我的姐妹

rows.en: She gazed at it for some time then added, ‘You don’t need bookcases at all.
rows.zh: 她盯着看了一会儿，又补充道：“你根本不需要书柜。”
rows.speaker: 旁白与我的姐妹

rows.en: You can sit here in your spare time and read the carpet!’
rows.zh: “空闲的时候，你可以坐在这里，读这块地毯！”
rows.speaker: 我的姐妹

rows.en: At last firemen have put out a big forest fire in California.
rows.zh: 消防队员终于扑灭了加利福尼亚州的一场森林大火。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Since then, they have been trying to find out how the fire began.
rows.zh: 此后，他们一直在设法查明火灾是怎么发生的。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Forest fires are often caused by broken glass or by cigarette ends which people carelessly throw away.
rows.zh: 森林火灾常常是由碎玻璃，或人们随手乱扔的烟头引起的。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Yesterday the firemen examined the ground carefully, but were not able to find any broken glass.
rows.zh: 昨天，消防队员仔细检查了地面，却没有找到任何碎玻璃。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: They were also quite sure that a cigarette end did not start the fire.
rows.zh: 他们也十分肯定，这场火不是烟头引起的。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: This morning, however, a firemen accidentally discovered the cause.
rows.zh: 然而，今天早晨，一名消防队员意外发现了起火原因。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: He noticed the remains of a snake which was wound round the electric wires of a 16,000-volt power line.
rows.zh: 他发现了一条蛇的残骸，缠在一条一万六千伏高压输电线路的电线上。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: In this way, he was able to solve the mystery.
rows.zh: 就这样，他解开了这个谜。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The explanation was simple but very unusual.
rows.zh: 原因很简单，却十分罕见。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: A bird had snatched up the snake from the ground and then dropped it on to the wires.
rows.zh: 一只鸟先从地上叼起了那条蛇，后来又把它丢到了电线上。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The snake then wound itself round the wires.
rows.zh: 蛇随后把身体缠在了电线上。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: When it did so, it sent sparks down to the ground and these immediately started a fire.
rows.zh: 蛇这么一缠，便使火花落到地面，立刻引起了火灾。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: After breakfast, I sent the children to school and then I went to the shops.
rows.zh: 早饭后，我把孩子们送到学校，然后去商店买东西。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: It was still early when I returned home.
rows.zh: 我回到家时还很早。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The children were at school, my husband was at work and the house was quiet.
rows.zh: 孩子们在上学，丈夫在上班，屋里静悄悄的。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: So I decided to make some meat pies.
rows.zh: 于是，我决定做些肉馅饼。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: In a short time I was busy mixing butter and flour and my hands were soon covered with sticky pastry.
rows.zh: 不一会儿，我就忙着把黄油和面粉混在一起，双手很快便沾满了黏糊糊的面团。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: At exactly that moment, the telephone rang.
rows.zh: 偏偏就在那一刻，电话铃响了。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Nothing could have been more annoying.
rows.zh: 真没有比这更烦人的事了。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: I picked up the receiver between two sticky fingers and was dismayed when I recognized the voice of Helen Bates.
rows.zh: 我用两个黏糊糊的手指夹起听筒，一听出是海伦·贝茨的声音，心里顿时发愁。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: It took me ten minutes to persuade her to ring back later.
rows.zh: 我花了十分钟，才说服她过一会儿再打来。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: At last I hung up the receiver.
rows.zh: 最后，我挂上了听筒。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: What a mess!
rows.zh: 真是一团糟！
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: There was pastry on my fingers, on the telephone, and on the doorknobs.
rows.zh: 我的手指上、电话上，连门把手上都沾着面团。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: I had no sooner got back to the kitchen than the doorbell rang loud enough to wake the dead.
rows.zh: 我刚回到厨房，门铃就响了，那声音大得简直能把死人吵醒。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: This time it was the postman and he wanted me to sign for a registered letter!
rows.zh: 这回是邮递员来了，他要我签收一封挂号信！
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Dreams of finding lost treasure almost came true recently.
rows.zh: 最近，找到失落宝藏的梦想差一点就实现了。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: A new machine called ‘The Revealer’ has been invented and it has been used to detect gold which has been buried in the ground.
rows.zh: 一种名叫“探宝者”的新机器已经被发明出来，并被用来探测埋在地下的黄金。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The machine was used in a cave near the seashore where — it is said — pirates used to hide gold.
rows.zh: 人们在海边的一个山洞里使用了这台机器，据说海盗从前常在那里藏金子。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The pirates would often bury gold in the cave and then fail to collect it.
rows.zh: 海盗常常把黄金埋进山洞里，后来却没能取走。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Armed with the new machine, a search party went into the cave hoping to find buried treasure.
rows.zh: 一支搜寻队带着这台新机器进入山洞，希望找到埋藏的财宝。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The leader of the party was examining the soil near the entrance to the cave when the machine showed that there was gold under the ground.
rows.zh: 队长正在检查洞口附近的泥土时，机器显示地下有黄金。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Very excited, the party dug a hole two feet deep.
rows.zh: 队员们激动极了，挖了一个两英尺深的坑。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: They finally found a small gold coin which was almost worthless.
rows.zh: 他们最后找到了一枚几乎不值钱的小金币。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The party then searched the whole cave thoroughly but did not find anything except an empty tin trunk.
rows.zh: 随后，搜寻队彻底搜查了整个山洞，但除了一只空铁皮箱，什么也没找到。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: In spite of this, many people are confident that ‘The Revealer’ may reveal something of value fairly soon.
rows.zh: 尽管如此，许多人仍然相信，“探宝者”很快就有可能找到有价值的东西。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Once a year, a race is held for old cars.
rows.zh: 老爷车比赛每年举行一次。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: A lot of cars entered for this race last year and there was a great deal of excitement just before it began.
rows.zh: 去年，许多汽车报名参加这场比赛，比赛开始前，现场十分热闹。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: One of the most handsome cars was a Rolls-Royce Silver Ghost.
rows.zh: 最漂亮的汽车之一是一辆劳斯莱斯“银魅”。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The most unusual car was a Benz which had only three wheels.
rows.zh: 最特别的汽车是一辆只有三个轮子的奔驰车。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Built in 1885, it was the oldest car taking part.
rows.zh: 这辆车造于1885年，是参赛车辆中年代最久的。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: After a great many loud explosions, the race began.
rows.zh: 一阵阵响亮的爆鸣声过后，比赛开始了。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Many of the cars broke down on the course and some drivers spent more time under their cars than in them!
rows.zh: 许多汽车在赛道上抛了锚，有些司机待在车底下的时间，比坐在车里的时间还多！
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: A few cars, however, completed the race.
rows.zh: 不过，还是有几辆汽车跑完了全程。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The winning car reached a speed of forty miles an hour — much faster than any of its rivals.
rows.zh: 获胜的那辆车达到了每小时四十英里的速度，比任何对手都快得多。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: It sped downhill at the end of the race and its driver had a lot of trouble trying to stop it.
rows.zh: 比赛快结束时，它飞快地冲下斜坡，司机费了很大劲才把它停住。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The race gave everyone a great deal of pleasure.
rows.zh: 这场比赛给大家带来了许多欢乐。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: It was very different from modern car races but no less exciting.
rows.zh: 它与现代赛车比赛大不相同，却同样令人兴奋。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: A woman in jeans stood at the window of an expensive shop.
rows.zh: 一位穿着牛仔裤的女士站在一家高档商店的橱窗前。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Though she hesitated for a moment, she finally went in and asked to see a dress that was in the window.
rows.zh: 虽然犹豫了一会儿，她最终还是走进店里，要求看看橱窗中的一件连衣裙。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The assistant who served her did not like the way she was dressed.
rows.zh: 接待她的店员不喜欢她的穿着。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Glancing at her scornfully, he told her that the dress was sold.
rows.zh: 他轻蔑地瞥了她一眼，告诉她那件连衣裙已经卖掉了。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The woman walked out of the shop angrily and decided to punish the assistant next day.
rows.zh: 女士生气地走出商店，决定第二天教训一下这个店员。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: She returned to the shop the following morning dressed in a fur coat, with a handbag in one hand and a long umbrella in the other.
rows.zh: 第二天早晨，她穿着一件裘皮大衣回到商店，一手提着手袋，另一手拿着一把长柄雨伞。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: After seeking out the rude assistant, she asked for the same dress.
rows.zh: 找到那个无礼的店员后，她要求看同一件连衣裙。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Not realizing who she was, the assistant was eager to serve her this time.
rows.zh: 店员没有认出她，这一次十分殷勤地为她服务。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: With great difficulty, he climbed into the shop window to get the dress.
rows.zh: 他费了很大劲爬进橱窗，去取那件连衣裙。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: As soon as she saw it, the woman said she did not like it.
rows.zh: 女士一看到裙子，就说自己不喜欢。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: She enjoyed herself making the assistant bring almost everything in the window before finally buying the dress she had first asked for.
rows.zh: 她兴致勃勃地让店员把橱窗里的东西几乎全拿了出来，最后才买下她一开始指名要的那件连衣裙。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The tiny village of Frinley is said to possess a ‘cursed tree’.
rows.zh: 据说，弗林利这个小村庄里有一棵“受了诅咒的树”。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Because the tree was mentioned in a newspaper, the number of visitors to Frinley has now increased.
rows.zh: 由于一家报纸提到了这棵树，现在到弗林利来的游客人数增加了。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The tree was planted near the church fifty years ago, but it is only in recent years that it has gained an evil reputation.
rows.zh: 这棵树是五十年前种在教堂附近的，但直到近几年才有了不祥的名声。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: It is said that if anyone touches the tree, he will have bad luck; if he picks a leaf, he will die.
rows.zh: 据说，谁要是碰了这棵树，就会倒霉；谁要是摘下一片叶子，就会死去。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Many villagers believe that the tree has already claimed a number of victims.
rows.zh: 许多村民相信，这棵树已经夺走了好几个人的性命。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The vicar has been asked to have the tree cut down, but so far he has refused.
rows.zh: 有人请牧师让人把树砍掉，但到目前为止，他一直拒绝这样做。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: He has pointed out that the tree is a useful source of income, as tourists have been coming from all parts of the country to see it.
rows.zh: 他指出，这棵树是一个很有用的收入来源，因为全国各地的游客都一直赶来看它。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: In spite of all that has been said, the tourists have been picking leaves and cutting their names on the tree-trunk.
rows.zh: 尽管有这些说法，游客们还是一直在摘树叶，并把自己的名字刻在树干上。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: So far, not one of them has been struck down by sudden death!
rows.zh: 到现在为止，他们中还没有一个人突然死去！
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Our dog, Rex, used to sit outside our front gate and bark.
rows.zh: 我们家的狗雷克斯以前常坐在大门外面叫。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Every time he wanted to come into the garden he would bark until someone opened the gate.
rows.zh: 每次它想进花园时，就一直叫，直到有人把门打开。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: As the neighbours complained of the noise, my husband spent weeks training him to press his paw on the latch to let himself in.
rows.zh: 由于邻居们抱怨太吵，我丈夫花了好几个星期，训练它用爪子按门闩，让自己进来。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Rex soon became an expert at opening the gate.
rows.zh: 雷克斯很快就成了开门能手。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: However, when I was going out shopping last week, I noticed him in the garden near the gate.
rows.zh: 可是上周我出门买东西时，看见它在花园里靠近大门的地方。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: This time he was barking so that someone would let him out!
rows.zh: 这一回，它叫个不停，是想让人把它放出去！
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Since then, he has developed another bad habit.
rows.zh: 从那以后，它又养成了另一个坏习惯。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: As soon as he opens the gate from the outside, he comes into the garden and waits until the gate shuts.
rows.zh: 它一从外面把门打开，就走进花园，等着门关上。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Then he sits and barks until someone lets him out.
rows.zh: 然后，它就坐在那里叫，直到有人把它放出去。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: After this he immediately lets himself in and begins barking again.
rows.zh: 这之后，它立刻又自己开门进来，接着再叫。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Yesterday my husband removed the gate and Rex got so annoyed we have not seen him since.
rows.zh: 昨天，我丈夫把大门拆掉了，雷克斯气坏了，从那以后我们就再也没有见到它。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: At a village fair, I decided to visit a fortune-teller called Madam Bellinsky.
rows.zh: 在一次乡村集市上，我决定去找一位叫贝林斯基夫人的算命者。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: I went into her tent and she told me to sit down.
rows.zh: 我走进她的帐篷，她让我坐下。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: After I had given her some money, she looked into a crystal ball and said: ‘A relation of yours is coming to see you.
rows.zh: 我给了她一些钱后，她望着一个水晶球说：“你的一位亲戚要来看你。”
rows.speaker: 旁白与贝林斯基夫人

rows.en: She will be arriving this evening and intends to stay for a few days.
rows.zh: “她今天傍晚就会到，打算住几天。”
rows.speaker: 贝林斯基夫人

rows.en: The moment you leave this tent, you will get a big surprise.
rows.zh: “你一离开这顶帐篷，就会大吃一惊。”
rows.speaker: 贝林斯基夫人

rows.en: A woman you know well will rush towards you.
rows.zh: “一位你很熟悉的女人会向你跑来。”
rows.speaker: 贝林斯基夫人

rows.en: She will speak to you and then she will lead you away from this place.
rows.zh: “她会跟你说话，然后领你离开这里。”
rows.speaker: 贝林斯基夫人

rows.en: That is all.’
rows.zh: “就这些。”
rows.speaker: 贝林斯基夫人

rows.en: As soon as I went outside, I forgot all about Madam Bellinsky because my wife hurried towards me.
rows.zh: 我一走出去，就把贝林斯基夫人的事忘得一干二净了，因为我的妻子正急匆匆地朝我走来。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: ‘Where have you been hiding?’ she asked impatiently.
rows.zh: “你躲到哪里去了？”她不耐烦地问。
rows.speaker: 妻子

rows.en: ‘Your sister will be here in less than an hour and we must be at the station to meet her.
rows.zh: “你的姐妹不到一个小时就会到，我们必须到车站去接她。”
rows.speaker: 妻子

rows.en: We are late already.’
rows.zh: “我们已经晚了。”
rows.speaker: 妻子

rows.en: As she walked away, I followed her out of the fair.
rows.zh: 她转身走开，我便跟着她离开了集市。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The Hubble telescope was launched into space by NASA on April 20, 1990 at a cost of over a billion dollars.
rows.zh: 哈勃望远镜于1990年4月20日由美国国家航空航天局发射升空，耗资超过十亿美元。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Right from the start there was trouble with the Hubble.
rows.zh: 从一开始，哈勃望远镜就出了问题。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The pictures it sent us were very disappointing because its main mirror was faulty!
rows.zh: 它传回的图像令人十分失望，因为它的主反射镜有缺陷！
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: NASA is now going to put the telescope right, so it will soon be sending up four astronauts to repair it.
rows.zh: 现在，美国国家航空航天局打算把望远镜修好，因此很快就会把四名宇航员送上太空进行维修。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The shuttle Endeavour will be taking the astronauts to the Hubble.
rows.zh: “奋进”号航天飞机将把宇航员送到哈勃望远镜那里。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: A robot-arm from the Endeavour will grab the telescope and hold it while the astronauts make the necessary repairs.
rows.zh: “奋进”号上的机械臂将抓住望远镜并将它固定住，让宇航员进行必要的维修。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Of course, the Hubble is above the earth’s atmosphere, so it will soon be sending us the clearest pictures of the stars and distant galaxies that we have ever seen.
rows.zh: 当然，哈勃位于地球大气层之外，因此很快就会向我们传回前所未有的清晰图像，展现恒星和遥远的星系。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The Hubble will tell us a great deal about the age and size of the universe.
rows.zh: 哈勃将告诉我们许多有关宇宙年龄和大小的事情。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: By the time you read this, the Hubble's eagle eye will have sent us thousands and thousands of wonderful pictures.
rows.zh: 等你读到这篇文章时，哈勃那只锐利的“鹰眼”就已经向我们传回了成千上万张精彩的照片。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Firemen had been fighting the forest fire for nearly three weeks before they could get it under control.
rows.zh: 消防队员与这场森林大火搏斗了将近三个星期，才把火势控制住。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: A short time before, great trees had covered the countryside for miles around.
rows.zh: 不久以前，周围绵延数英里的乡野还长满了参天大树。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Now, smoke still rose up from the warm ground over the desolate hills.
rows.zh: 如今，荒凉的山坡上，仍有烟从温热的地面升起。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Winter was coming on and the hills threatened the surrounding villages with destruction, for heavy rain would not only wash away the soil but would cause serious floods as well.
rows.zh: 冬天快到了，这些山坡给周围的村庄带来了毁灭的威胁，因为大雨不仅会冲走泥土，还会造成严重的洪水。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: When the fire had at last been put out, the forest authorities ordered several tons of a special type of grass-seed which would grow quickly.
rows.zh: 大火终于扑灭后，林业部门订购了数吨生长迅速的特殊草籽。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The seed was sprayed over the ground in huge quantities by aeroplanes.
rows.zh: 飞机把大量草籽撒到了地面上。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The planes had been planting seed for nearly a month when it began to rain.
rows.zh: 飞机播撒草籽将近一个月时，天开始下雨了。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: By then, however, in many places the grass had already taken root.
rows.zh: 不过，到那时，许多地方的草已经扎下了根。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: In place of the great trees which had been growing there for centuries, patches of green had begun to appear in the blackened soil.
rows.zh: 原先几个世纪以来一直长着参天大树的地方，如今在焦黑的泥土上已经开始出现一片片新绿。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Jeremy Hampden has a large circle of friends and is very popular at parties.
rows.zh: 杰里米·汉普登交友广泛，在聚会上很受欢迎。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Everybody admires him for his great sense of humour — everybody. that is, except his six-year-old daughter, Jenny.
rows.zh: 人人都佩服他出众的幽默感——确切地说，除了他六岁的女儿珍妮以外，人人都是如此。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Recently, one of Jeremy's closest friends asked him to make a speech at a wedding reception.
rows.zh: 最近，杰里米一位最要好的朋友请他在婚宴上讲几句话。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: This is the sort of thing that Jeremy loves.
rows.zh: 这正是杰里米喜欢做的事。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: He prepared the speech carefully and went to the wedding with Jenny.
rows.zh: 他认真准备了讲话，并带着珍妮去参加婚礼。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: He had included a large number of funny stories in the speech and, of course, it was a great success.
rows.zh: 他在讲话中穿插了许多有趣的故事，当然，讲话大获成功。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: As soon as he had finished, Jenny told him she wanted to go home.
rows.zh: 他刚讲完，珍妮就告诉他，她想回家。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Jeremy was a little disappointed by this but he did as his daughter asked.
rows.zh: 杰里米对此有些失望，不过还是照女儿的意思做了。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: On the way home, he asked Jenny if she had enjoyed the speech.
rows.zh: 回家的路上，他问珍妮是否喜欢他的讲话。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: To his surprise, she said she hadn’t.
rows.zh: 让他吃惊的是，她说不喜欢。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Jeremy asked her why this was so and she told him that she did not like to see so many people laughing at him!
rows.zh: 杰里米问她为什么，她告诉他，自己不喜欢看到那么多人嘲笑他！
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: In 1858, a French engineer, Aimé Thomé de Gamond, arrived in England with a plan for a twenty-one-mile tunnel under the English Channel.
rows.zh: 1858年，法国工程师艾梅·托梅·德·加蒙带着一项计划来到英国，打算在英吉利海峡下面修建一条二十一英里长的隧道。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: He said that it would be possible to build a platform in the centre of the Channel.
rows.zh: 他说，可以在海峡中央建造一个平台。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: This platform would serve as a port and a railway station.
rows.zh: 这个平台将兼作港口和火车站。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The tunnel would be well-ventilated if tall chimneys were built above sea level.
rows.zh: 如果在海面上方建造高高的通风烟囱，隧道内就能保持良好的通风。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: In 1860, a better plan was put forward by an Englishman, William Low.
rows.zh: 1860年，一位名叫威廉·洛的英国人提出了一个更好的方案。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: He suggested that a double railway-tunnel should be built.
rows.zh: 他建议修建两条并行的铁路隧道。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: This would solve the problem of ventilation, for if a train entered this tunnel, it would draw in fresh air behind it.
rows.zh: 这将解决通风问题，因为火车驶入这条隧道时，会从后方带入新鲜空气。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Forty-two years later a tunnel was actually begun.
rows.zh: 四十二年后，隧道工程真的开工了。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: If, at the time, the British had not feared invasion, it would have been completed.
rows.zh: 如果当时英国人没有害怕遭到入侵，隧道本来就能修建完成。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The world had to wait almost another 100 years for the Channel Tunnel.
rows.zh: 世界又等了将近一百年，才等来海峡隧道。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: It was officially opened on March 7, 1994, finally connecting Britain to the European continent.
rows.zh: 它于1994年3月7日正式开通，终于把英国与欧洲大陆连接起来。
rows.speaker: 旁白
